title: Move quorum ledger mutation and compaction behind the Fleet socket
goal: Vision: V-10. Preserve public append, batch append and compaction path APIs and typed errors while moving their runtime implementation and regression corpus into the proven Fleet destination. Reuse: existing authenticated fleet.cluster.v1 ledger action, current MacPolicy filesystem grants, original retained Apache ledger implementation and existing EaiError rewrap. No new dependency. Core removal follows Windows and Linux socket parity, custom-path authorization and exact old/new file outcomes.

reuse.searched: Existing authenticated fleet.cluster.v1 ledger_v1 action, current MacPolicy filesystem grants, EaiError rewrap and retained Apache ledger at b576e1e34. Original tests and Ed25519 signing helpers move with the destination; no new core dependency.

limitations: Serving requires the authenticated Fleet cluster implementation in susi-plug-host. Original public path signatures, native filenames and typed error metadata are retained. Windows and Ubuntu WSL socket comparisons pass; source publication waits for the relocated original security tests and serialized size ceiling. No installed release promotion.
